parameters.query: SELECT id, sku, name, description, price, currency FROM products WHERE active = true AND business_id = $2::uuid AND (name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR sku ILIKE $1) LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO quotes (business_id, contact_id, conversation_id, quote_number, status, subtotal, tax, discount, total, currency, notes, valid_until, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $9, $5, 0, 0, $6, $7, $8, NOW() + INTERVAL '14 days', $10) ON CONFLICT (quote_number) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, quote_number, total, currency, valid_until;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('quote', $1::uuid, 'quote_created', NULL, 'ai', 'Quote generated via AI tool', jsonb_build_object('quote_number', $2), jsonb_build_object('request_id', $3, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;
